In Pakistan, government-funded universities are a major source of higher education. They provide affordable education. Over 80% of students are enrolled in these universities' various academic programs in Pakistan yearly.

In this article, we've listed the top ones among them and why they stand out. Keep reading to learn everything about the top public universities in Pakistan.

Overview of Public Universities in Pakistan

The journey of Public universities in Pakistan started with a mission to provide quality education to everyone. From the first public university, the University of the Punjab (1882), to the new ones, they've become the backbone of the nation's education sector.

The government has implemented various policies and initiatives to support the growth of these universities. These universities are hubs of innovation and research, contributing in countless ways to the country's development. Whether it's groundbreaking research or producing future leaders, public universities in Pakistan are at the forefront of it all.

Criteria for Ranking

While ranking universities, we look at several important factors to ensure we're highlighting the best. Here's how we break it down:

Academic Excellence: We assessed the quality of the teachers, the student-to-teacher ratio, and the university's emphasis on research.

Infrastructure: We took a look at the campus itself, including its libraries, labs, and student accommodations. Great facilities can make a big difference in a student's experience.

Student Support Services: We considered the various forms of support available to students, including scholarships, financial aid, and career counselling.

Reputation and Accreditation: We checked the university's rankings and national or international recognitions. A university with a strong reputation and proper accreditation is often more respected in the job market.

Top 10 Public Universities in Pakistan 2026

Here's a detailed look at our top 10 Public Universities in Pakistan:

1. Quaid-i-Azam University, Islamabad

Quaid-i-Azam University is the best public university in Pakistan. Located in the heart of the capital, Quaid-e-Azam University (QAU) is Pakistan's beacon of higher education. What sets QAU apart is its commitment to academic excellence and research. Recognised nationally and internationally, QAU consistently ranks among the best Pakistani universities. Your degree is highly valued here, opening doors to opportunities both at home and abroad.

Key Departments:

  • Biological Sciences
  • Social Sciences
  • Natural Sciences
  • Business Administration
  • Law

Notable Features:

  • Highly qualified faculty
  • A strong research background
  • Collaboration with international institutions
  • Extensive library and research facilities

Overall Details:

Tuition Fee: 2,00,000-3,57,580 PKR

Undergraduate Duration: 4 years

Postgraduate Duration: 2 years (Master's), 3-5 years (PhD.)

Established: 1967

Total Programs: 50+ undergraduate and postgraduate programs

Total Students: 31,150

Total Faculty: 1,340

Location: Islamabad

2. University of the Punjab, Lahore

Punjab University is one of the oldest and most prestigious universities in Pakistan. Its long history is a testament to its quality and resilience. The university is renowned for its extensive academic offerings, encompassing a wide range of disciplines, from the arts to the sciences. Students flock here for its affordable education, rich library resources, and expansive campus.

Key Departments:

  • Business, Economics and Administrative Sciences
  • Electrical, Energy & Environmental Engineering
  • Computing & Information Technology
  • Information and Media Studies
  • Life-Sciences
  • Geo-Sciences
  • Arts and Humanities
  • Islamic Studies
  • Law
  • Social and Behavioural Sciences
  • Agricultural Sciences

Notable Features:

  • Large and well-equipped campus
  • Strong research and innovation
  • A wide range of academic programs
  • Active clubs and societies for students

Overall Details:

Tuition Fee: 56,440-1,94,600 PKR

Undergraduate Duration: 4 years

Postgraduate Duration: 2 years (Master's), 3-5 years (PhD.)

Established: 1882

Total Programs: 70+ undergraduate and postgraduate programs

Total Students: Over 45,000

Total Faculty: Approximately 1,000

Location: Lahore, Punjab

3. COMSATS Institute of Information Technology (CIIT), Islamabad

CIIT is one of the best institutes in Pakistan, especially in the fields of IT and engineering. Known for its modern approach and cutting-edge research, CIIT attracts students who are passionate about these fields. Plus, its strong industry connections also make its degrees highly valued. The university's rise in rankings and rapidly expanding alumni network are proof of its growing influence.

Key Departments:

  • Computer Science
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Mathematics
  • Management Sciences
  • Physics

Notable Features:

  • IT and engineering expertise
  • Collaboration with international universities
  • Active participation in national and international conferences

Overall Details:

Tuition Fee: 99,000-168,000 PKR

Undergraduate Duration: 4 years

Postgraduate Duration: 2 years (Master's), 3-5 years (PhD.)

Established: 1998

Total Programs: 40+ undergraduate and postgraduate programs

Total Students: 33,744

Total Faculty: 2,444

Location: Islamabad, Capital Territory

4. National University of Sciences and Technology (NUST)

National University of Sciences and Technology is another top public university in Pakistan. Ranked among the top research universities in Pakistan, NUST offers a dynamic learning environment. The university's campus is one of the most modern in the country. That's equipped with cutting-edge labs, research centres, and recreational facilities. NUST's degrees, particularly in engineering and technology, are highly sought after by employers.

Key Departments:

  • Electrical Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Computer Science
  • Business Administration
  • Civil Engineering

Notable Features:

  • Huge research facilities
  • Strong industry-academia linkages
  • Highly qualified faculty
  • Advanced campus infrastructure

Overall Details:

Tuition Fee: 13,70,800 PKR

Undergraduate Duration: 4 years

Postgraduate Duration: 2 years (Master's), 3-5 years (PhD.)

Established: 1991

Total Programs: 60+ undergraduate and postgraduate programs

Total Students: 12,468

Total Faculty: 1,637

Location: Islamabad, Capital Territory

5. Pakistan Institute of Engineering and Applied Sciences (PIEAS), Islamabad

Pakistan Institute of Engineering and Applied Sciences is another of the best public universities in Pakistan. When it comes to engineering and applied sciences, PIEAS commands respect. This university is known for its rigorous academic programs and strong research culture. Though not large, the campus is well-equipped with the latest technology and research facilities. A degree from PIEAS is highly regarded, particularly in the field of engineering.

Key Departments:

  • Nuclear Engineering
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Chemical Engineering
  • Computer Science

Notable Features:

  • Research in nuclear and applied sciences
  • Collaboration with national and international research organisations
  • State-of-the-art laboratories
  • Highly selective admission process

Overall Details:

Tuition Fee: 482000 PKR

Undergraduate Duration: 4 years

Postgraduate Duration: 2 years (Master's), 3-5 years (PhD.)

Established: 1967

Total Programs: 28 undergraduate and postgraduate programs

Total Students: 1,518

Total Faculty: 167

Location: Islamabad, Capital Territory

6. University of Engineering and Technology (UET)

UET is a dream destination for aspiring engineers in Pakistan. It's another of the best universities located in Lahore, with a history spanning over a century. UET's sprawling campus, with its historic buildings and modern amenities, provides a perfect blend. Graduates from here are highly sought after in the job market.

Key Departments:

  • Civil Engineering
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Chemical Engineering
  • Architecture

Notable Features:

  • Extensive engineering programs
  • International research collaboration
  • Well-equipped laboratories and workshops

Overall Details:

Tuition Fee: 4,04,350-5,17,404 PKR

Undergraduate Duration: 4 years

Postgraduate Duration: 2-2.5 years

Established: 1921

Total Programs: 35+ undergraduate and postgraduate programs

Total Students: 12,503

Total Faculty: 1,014

Location: Lahore, Punjab

7. University of Peshawar (UoP), Peshawar

Founded in 1950, UoP is one of the oldest universities and one of the most respected. It serves as a hub for cultural and academic activities, attracting students from across the country. Peshawar, the largest city in the province, is a beautiful and friendly place. Plus, the university campus is rich in history. The degrees from UoP carry significant weight.

Key Departments:

  • Arts and Humanities
  • Social Sciences
  • Natural Sciences
  • Business Administration
  • Law

Notable Features:

  • Strong research centres
  • A rich history and academic legacy
  • Extensive library

Overall Details:

Tuition Fee: 318400-675200 PKR

Undergraduate Duration: 4 years

Postgraduate Duration: 2 years (Master's), 3-5 years (PhD.)

Established: 1950

Total Programs: 48+ undergraduate and postgraduate programs

Total Students: 14,359+

Total Faculty: 606+

Location: Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa

8. Institute of Business Administration (IBA), Karachi

IBA Karachi is the ideal destination for those seeking a career in business. Established in 1955, IBA has a long-standing reputation as one of the best business schools in Pakistan. The campus is modern and well-equipped. Degrees from IBA are highly valued in the business world. Also, its alumni network includes some of the most influential business leaders in Pakistan.

Key Departments:

  • Business Administration
  • Economics and Finance
  • Social Sciences and Liberal Arts
  • Computer Science
  • Mathematics

Notable Features:

  • Strong industry connections
  • Huge internship opportunities
  • Emphasis on entrepreneurship and leadership development
  • Active alumni network

Overall Details:

Tuition Fee:

Undergraduate Duration: 4 years

Postgraduate Duration: 2 years (Master's), 3-5 years (PhD.)

Established: 1955

Total Programs: 20+ undergraduate and postgraduate programs

Total Students: 4900+

Total Faculty: 250+

Location: Karachi, Sindh

9. Government College University, Faisalabad (GCUF)

GCUF is another leading public university in Pakistan. It's known for its wide array of academic programs, from social sciences to natural sciences. The university campus has modern facilities, including advanced labs and libraries. Degrees from here are respected nationwide, and its graduates are known for their academic rigour.

Key Departments:

  • Arts and Social Sciences
  • Science and Technology
  • Management and Administrative Sciences
  • Life Sciences
  • Pharmacy

Notable Features:

  • Strong focus on research and innovation
  • Extensive community outreach
  • Wide range of extracurricular activities

Overall Details:

Tuition Fee: 3,85,700-4,00,000 PKR

Undergraduate Duration: 4 years

Postgraduate Duration: 2 years (Master's), 3-5 years (PhD.)

Established: 1897 (as a college), 2002 (as a university)

Total Programs: 60+ undergraduate and postgraduate programs

Total Students: 2,219

Total Faculty: 1,846

Location: Faisalabad, Punjab

10. University of Karachi, Karachi

The University of Karachi is a cornerstone of higher education in Pakistan. With more than 52 departments, it has strong academic programs. Established in 1951, this university has built a reputation for excellence in teaching and 19 research institutes. The university is well-regarded for producing highly skilled graduates.

Key Departments:

  • Business Administration
  • Computer Science
  • Economics
  • Law
  • Social Sciences
  • Natural Sciences

Notable Features:

  • Extensive library
  • Modern research facilities and laboratories
  • Active student clubs and organisations
  • Strong industry connections
  • Internship opportunities

Overall Details:

Tuition Fee: 176000-377498 PKR

Undergraduate Duration: 4 years

Postgraduate Duration: 2 years (Master's), 3-5 years (PhD.)

Established: 1951

Total Programs: 60+ undergraduate and postgraduate programs

Total Students: 44,969

Total Faculty: 1,063

Location: Karachi, Sindh

Factors to Consider When Choosing a University

Choosing the right higher education institution can impact your future a lot. So, before you decide which one to select, remember to consider these:

  • Academic Fit: Ensure the university offers programs/degrees that align with your interests.
  • Financial Considerations: Evaluate the tuition fees, scholarships, and financial aid options available.
  • Campus Life: Consider the importance of extracurricular activities, student clubs, and support services in your university experience.
  • Location and Accessibility: Consider the university's location, transportation options, and the ease of commuting.

Conclusion

In conclusion, public universities in Pakistan are vital to providing accessible education. The top institutions mentioned here are known for their high academic quality. Choosing the right university can significantly impact your future career. Consider all the factors mentioned to make an informed decision.
